interactions.body:
Hello! You have already received the Power of the
Dragon Eye today. The process weakens me so much
that I can only help you once a day. Come again
tomorrow!

What? Rice Cake? Is that a new weapon?! Yes, well
then you can...
Oh, you mean edible Rice Cakes. Why didn't you
just say that in the first place? You'd better go
to Octavio. He knows all there is to know about
food.
interactions.title: Weapon Shop Dealer:

interactions.body:
My so-called husband is married to his books. He
barely even looks at me any more. And I'm not an
ugly woman.
interactions.title: Aranyo:

interactions.body:
Nakajima... he's alive? My darling husband is
alive? I can't thank you enough for telling me!
It was the Valley of Yonjang that he was talking
about. I'm going to head there immediately and
meet him.
interactions.title: Ah-Yu:

interactions.body:
My friend, the world is full of unanswered
questions. And I, am a seeker of answers and a
seeker of knowledge. Have you ever heard of epic
weapons and Spirit Stones?
interactions.title: Seon-Pyeong:

interactions.body:
Greetings!
I am responsible for upgrading items. If you want
to upgrade an item, just bring it to me.
interactions.title: Blacksmith

interactions.body:
Oh, adventurer! The world is full of problems.
You can only survive with a certain amount of
knowledge. So honour you books. In bad times -
and nowadays the times are always bad - they will
help you. Believe me!
interactions.title: Soon, the bookworm:

interactions.body:
My beloved Celadon Porcelain! It's been in my
family for three generations and now three of the
precious vases are broken. I saw that
ne'er-do-well Taurean hanging around the
warehouse earlier. I'm sure he's to blame!
interactions.title: Yonah:

interactions.body:
Heaven, please help me...
I study all kind of plants in this kingdom. There
is tons of work that needs to be done. I do not
have the time to go hunt plants on my own. Will
you please help me?
interactions.title: Biologist Chaegirab:

interactions.body:
Be quiet and maintain your discipline! Behave and
don't start any trouble. You should respect your
fellow men. Is that understood?

All this talk about food is making me hungry.
I'm really craving a Hotpot with venison, bear,
cabbage and two eggs.
interactions.title: Armour Shop Dealer:

interactions.body: Hello! How are you, what can I do for you?
interactions.title: Baek-Go:

interactions.body:
Buy betting slips for your kingdom.

1. For every guild war, there is a pre-announced
projection of the possible outcome announcing the
potential winners.
2. You can buy a betting slip. On the betting
slip you can write whether you think that the
guild you believe in will achieve the results
forecast.
3. The choices are determined by the betting
booth. After the guild war, you will be informed
whether you have won or lost.

* 10% of the winnings will be paid out to the
kingdom.
interactions.title: The guild bet

interactions.body:
You can get the red potion from the General Store
Saleswoman. She's over there. If you can't see
her, go towards the flashing circle on the big
map or the flashing red dot on the mini map!
interactions.title: Guardian:

interactions.body:
I used to collect Peach Blossoms with my brother.
But I have to do it alone today. They don't look
very pretty, but they have a special effect.
If you take a Peach Blossom to Baek-Go, he'll
brew a potion from it that makes you very
nimble-footed!

Excuse me, if you aren't busy at the moment,
could you do me a favour? I need an Empty Bottle
for my Red Potion.
interactions.title: General Store Saleswoman:

interactions.body:
It's hard to get our troops motivated at the
moment, especially as it's so hard to get fresh
supplies. The General Store Saleswoman, an
important supplier of ours, has only been sending
us a small amount of the potions that we need.
interactions.title: Captain

interactions.body:
My uncle Chaegirab has dedicated his life to
science and has invested all his Yang into his
research. He's always been good to me, so I would
like to surprise him with a gift. Would you go to
Uriel and ask him whether he has an idea of what
I could give him? He's my uncle's old teacher and
he knows him very well.
interactions.title: Wonda-Rim:

interactions.body:
Do you want to use the Storeroom?
You will however, have to pay Yang to use the
Storeroom. I'm in a good mood today so you can
use it for just 500 Yang. So - come on, that's
cheap, isn't it?
interactions.title: Storekeeper:

interactions.body:
The look in your eyes tells me that you are very
young. Why do you want to know your fate so early
on in your life? Is there a particular reason for
it? Fate still has a lot in store for you. Come
back again later.
interactions.title: Old Lady

interactions.body:
To start a horse mission, you need a Horse Medal.
You can get one in the monkey dungeon.
interactions.title: Stable Boy:

interactions.body:
That's the memorial. Ah, there it is! I have the
page!

Welcome! Our traditional restaurant is so
successful that we could open restaurants
worldwide. If you want to have something yummy to
eat, then come around and give our food a try.
interactions.title: Octavio, the restaurant owner:

interactions.body:
These Flowers look like the ones Ariyoung
described. I'm going to take some.

Hello! I know how you can get to other regions
from here. If you give me some Yang, I can
teleport you there.
interactions.title: Old Man:

interactions.body:
This is a fascinating place. But does anything
out of the ordinary ever happen here? Probably
not. In other parts of the country, everything
looks a little different! I'm sure there's
somewhere interesting that I could teleport you
to. As the powers of evil have got stronger
again, time and space has been thrown into chaos.
Your return might not always work. Do you want to
be teleported anyway?
interactions.title: Teleporter:

interactions.body:
Greetings.
Your work the last time was very helpful. With
your help, I was able to make some real progress.
But now I have a problem. While investigating
some information about the meteors, I found an
old book. As far as I can understand, there are
important speculations about the cause of the
changes in there, that are affecting our country.
It is really important.
interactions.title: Uriel:

interactions.body:
So you're interested in the secrets of improving
your Fishing Pole? To be honest, it's not really
a big secret. The more time you spend fishing,
the more points your Fishing Pole will collect.
When your Fishing Pole has reached its maximum
level, bring it to me. Then I'll try to upgrade
it for you.
OK. Now choose the Fishing Pole that you would
like to upgrade and give it to me.

interactions.title: Fisherman:

interactions.body:
The writing looks really archaic... it's also
very shaky and uneven, as if the author didn't
have much strength left...

A student of Body-Force training trains his body
strength and learns how to use it in the best
way. His attacks inflict deep wounds, so that his
opponents are easily and quickly defeated.
interactions.title: Body-Force training

interactions.body:
Mental-Fight training teaches to attack the enemy
with strong chi attacks and how to defend
yourself from his attacks.
interactions.title: Mental-Fight training

interactions.body:
In Blade-Fight training a Ninja learns how to
quickly and lethally hit his opponent's weak
points.
interactions.title: Blade-Fight training

interactions.body:
In Archery training a Ninja learns how to handle
his bow and to fight the enemy with precision
from a distance.
interactions.title: Archery training
Weaponry training

interactions.body:
In Black Magic training you learn the art of
weakening your enemies from a distance with black
magic.
interactions.title: Black Magic training

interactions.body:
The Dragon Force training uses the strong fire
attacks from the Dragon God as well as support
magic which can give the group the protection
from the Dragon God.
interactions.title: Dragon Force training

interactions.body:
With the Healing Force training, you learn to
stun your enemies with electric shocks. You also
learn to heal group members and give them
additional strength.
interactions.title: Healing Force training

interactions.body:
It's getting better. While taking a walk
recently, I stumbled over a Gango Root and
sprained my ankle. Luckily I know the doctor
Baek-Go, so he treated me and gave me some
advice: To heal small wounds you can brew a
potion from these same Gango Roots. So I made the
culprit roots into a tea and it cured the damage
that it had made...
interactions.title: Handu-Up:
